facts.fact: Digital minister Aurelie Adam Soule Zoumarou said on 21 November 2024 that people can use more than 200 e-services on service-public.bj.

The digital minister said service-public.bj had handled over 1 million water bill payments, nearly 900,000 electricity bill payments, over 500,000 criminal record requests, over 80,000 e-visas and over 200,000 passport requests.

BEN.note: Nothing stated about the national ID system.
Criminal record requests are an identification or public service, not a station record of reports or cases.
